visual_summary: A young dark-haired figure hesitates with a blade while an older, long-haired armored man thrusts an ornate firearm toward him and commands him to fight. In the main action panel, the older man fires a bright energy shot across a machinery-filled interior at a larger opponent or target on the right, while a small hovering robot is centered between them. Subsequent close-ups show the shooter aiming with grim determination, the young figure recoiling and raising an arm, and the firefight continuing with repeated blasts and flying shell casings.
